# Markdown Basics

Regular paragraphs, **bold text**, *italic text*, `inline code`, and
[links](https://quarto.org) all work as expected.

## Lists

- First bullet
- Second bullet with $\NN$ math
- Third bullet

1. First step
2. Second step
3. Third step

## Tables

| Environment   | Label  |
|---------------|--------|
| `theorem`     | `The.` |
| `definition`  | `Def.` |
| `corollar`    | `Cor.` |
| `lemma`       | `Lem.` |
| `proposition` | `Prop.`|

## Code

```python
def greet(name: str) -> str:
    return f"Hello, {name}!"
```

# Callouts

::: tipp
Tips use the `tipp` class and render with a blue heading.
:::

::: {.warnung title="Watch out"}
Warnings use the `warnung` class and accept an optional title.
:::

::: default
The `default` class renders a neutral gray callout.
:::

Callouts can also be written directly in raw Typst:

```{=typst}
#tipp(title: "Raw Typst", [This callout bypasses the Markdown filter.])
```

# Theorem Environments

::: theorem
A theorem statement. The body may contain **Markdown formatting** and math
such as $\RR$.
:::

::: {.theorem title="Pythagorean theorem"}
In a right triangle with legs $a$ and $b$ and hypotenuse $c$:
$a^2 + b^2 = c^2$.
:::

::: definition
A definition block.
:::

::: {.definition title="Natural numbers"}
The natural numbers are defined as $\NN = \{1, 2, 3, \dots\}$.
:::

::: corollar
A corollary block.
:::

::: lemma
A lemma block.
:::

::: proposition
A proposition block.
:::

# Math Macros

| Macro | Renders as   |
|-------|--------------|
| `\NN` | $\mathbb{N}$ |
| `\ZZ` | $\mathbb{Z}$ |
| `\QQ` | $\mathbb{Q}$ |
| `\RR` | $\mathbb{R}$ |
| `\CC` | $\mathbb{C}$ |
| `\LL` | $\mathbb{L}$ |

Display math also supports the macros:

$$
\NN \subset \ZZ \subset \QQ \subset \RR \subset \CC
$$

# Configuration

Set the number of columns and the body font size in the YAML front matter:

```yaml
format: cheatsheet-typst
cols: 3
font-size: 9pt
```
